title: SDA: Steering-Driven Distribution Alignment for Open LLMs without Fine-Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Pairwise scoring using GPT-4.1 as an external evaluator to judge model responses to adversarial and harmful queries (from the BeaverTails and HarmfulQA datasets). The evaluation rates outputs on a scale of 1 to 100 for 'harmlessness', specifically penalizing toxicity, bias, discrimination, and offensive content.
